video_title: LeBron’s Best Free Agency Landing Spots + Reaction To Blockbuster Kawhi Trade

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James and the Lakers have mutually decided to move on
quotes.excerpt: I'm calling it a conscious uncoupling. He has decided that he is going to move on from the Lakers.
quotes.quote: We had a minor news day by NBA standards. You may have heard LeBron James has decided that he is going to move on from the Lakers, and the Lakers are prepared to move on from him. For the moment, it's not acrimonious. We'll see if it remains that way going forward, but there's too much going forward to pay attention to. So, we'll deal with that if it gets to this point and things are moving on.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James wants to play for a competitive team
quotes.excerpt: He wants to play in a very competitive team. He wants to play meaningful basketball.
quotes.quote: The two big things that came to light were that number one, LeBron continues to want to play. I was just very cautious because I hadn't heard that until today, and it was explained to me that LeBron does want to play. And also, he wants to play in a very competitive team. He wants to play meaningful basketball. Money is not the number one importance, his basketball happiness is.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James is likely to take less than the max
quotes.excerpt: I'll play for less than the max and even less than a very large amount of money.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Bobby, that's code for I'll play for less than the max and even less than a very large amount of money. I don't know yet if that means he'll play for the minimum or if he's going to want an exception.

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Marks
text_blocks.text: I'll say this, Windy got a break today on the show tonight because when Richard rolled in and you had Perk, and Will Schump was kind of taking a backseat, Brian had like a 45-minute break from talking during the show. And I was on air.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The Cavaliers are the best landing spot for LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: If it's just about maximizing the chance to win a championship, then he's going back home.
quotes.quote: I still think if it's just about maximizing the chance to win a championship, then he's going back home. Then I think that the Cavaliers would have the best chance. If James Harden becomes their fourth best player, that to me is their best chance. It's also the best storybook ending if this is indeed the last year to go back for a third time, the place obviously where it all started, where he delivered the first championship in what 50 whatever years in the city's pro sports history.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Golden State is an intriguing option for LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: If it's about money, you go to Golden State where they can put together the full mid-level.
quotes.quote: If it's about money, you go to Golden State where they can put together the full mid-level. And it's an awfully intriguing thing to see LeBron and Steph kind of in their twilight together. It would be really weird to see him in a Warriors uniform though, I ain't going to lie.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James can take his time in free agency
quotes.excerpt: Because LeBron is probably taking an exception, he can sit here and wait and watch.
quotes.quote: Because LeBron is probably taking an exception, even if it's the minimum exception, he can sit here and wait and watch. He's not going to slow free agency down, he's not going to slow a team's business down. And it sounds like he's going to take some meetings, and whether it's him or it's just Rich Paul taking the meetings, these meetings he's going to take, yeah, he's going to want to hear what the team's plan is.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown to the Cavaliers is a potential trade scenario
quotes.excerpt: You threw out a potential Jaylen Brown to Cleveland deal for that reason.
quotes.quote: You threw out a potential Jaylen Brown to Cleveland deal for that reason, like as the, hey, take that swing, get Jaylen Brown, well that will open up LeBron's eyes. But to me, if you're giving up Evan Mobley in that deal, are you getting better if you're the Cavaliers?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Cleveland should make a roster move to attract LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: If you're Cleveland, what you should consider is some sort of significant roster move to sweeten the pot.
quotes.quote: If you're Cleveland, what you should consider is some sort of significant roster move to sweeten the pot for LeBron. Now, they can't do it with money, they got to differentiate with themselves. They could have offered Evan Mobley for Giannis Antetokounmpo. They didn't go that direction, I think largely because Giannis did not have Cleveland on his list for places he would extend. They could have offered Evan Mobley for Jaylen Brown yesterday, and I think the Celtics would have significant interest there. Apparently the Cavs don't like the idea of Evan Mobley for Giannis, and they don't like the idea of Evan Mobley for Jaylen, otherwise they probably would have seriously pursued that.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Wizards have made it known Anthony Davis is unavailable
quotes.excerpt: Mark Spears came out and reported today that the Wizards have made it be known that Anthony Davis is not available.
quotes.quote: Mark Spears came out and reported today that the Wizards have made it be known that Anthony Davis is not available. At any price.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Lakers have 52 million in salary cap space
quotes.excerpt: They enter free agency having locked up Austin Reaves on a max deal. They have 52-ish million dollars.
quotes.quote: The Lakers now have clarity after sort of sitting on some level of the fence for a couple of months here. They enter free agency having locked up Austin Reaves on a max deal. They have 52-ish million dollars. As we're recording this pod, they haven't used any of it yet, although I think they've got a couple of free agent role players that they're lining up.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: The Lakers are in a difficult restricted free agency market
quotes.excerpt: Restricted free agency is like arbitration, right? You go in front of somebody and they tell you why.
quotes.quote: Restricted free agency is like arbitration, right? You go in front of somebody and they tell you why all your all your flaws and they say basically go get a go get an offer sheet from some somebody out there. And when you look at Durren and Kessler and Peyton Watson, it's probably a little bit different like, you know, the two centers. We've talked about the Lakers with them and it's like, do you really want to tie up all your money for seven days and then come July 7th at midnight be like, oh, everybody's off the board.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The Lakers are expected to sign Quentin Grimes
quotes.excerpt: The anticipation around the league is that they're going to be signing Quentin Grimes.
quotes.quote: The anticipation around the league is that they're going to be signing Quentin Grimes, and that they're going to be signing Sandro Mamukelashvili. Luke Kennard is already out the door, he took the little taxpayer mid-level from Phoenix. And then the anticipation is that Marcus Smart will be out the door, likely to Houston.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Raptors and Clippers have agreed to a Kawhi Leonard trade
quotes.excerpt: The Raptors and Clippers come to an agreement to send Kawhi Leonard back.
quotes.quote: The Raptors and Clippers come to an agreement to send Kawhi Leonard back. I don't know if I can say this full circle, because full circle would be back to where he started, which is San Antonio. I don't know if I can say that. But this trade where two unprotected first and an unprotected pick swap go to the to the Clippers, along with Brandon Ingram to a who was an All-Star last year, am I right? Didn't he make the All-Star team?

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Toronto was a scrappy team that maximized its potential
quotes.excerpt: Toronto was a good team last year, a scrappy team that probably maximized its potential.
quotes.quote: Toronto was a good team last year, a scrappy team that probably maximized its potential. But the their ceiling wasn't that high because they were an average offensive team that, you know, didn't have an elite half-court creator and they were a team that desperately needed a closer, especially come playoff time.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard is an elite playoff performer
quotes.excerpt: Kawhi is one of the great playoff performers when he's on the floor of this generation.
quotes.quote: Kawhi is one of the great playoff performers when he's on the floor of this generation. And Kawhi is still like Kawhi is coming off his best offensive season. He is an awesome half-court offensive player. I think you can make an argument that a healthy Kawhi and Scottie Barnes is the best tandem in the East, especially pending what happens in Boston. Um, you know, if the Celtics, if Jaylen Brown still there, the Celtics have an argument, but whatever, it's a, it's damn sure high on the list.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The NBA Cup final is moving to Hinkle Fieldhouse
quotes.excerpt: The NBA Cup is moving out of Las Vegas after two glorious years and into the site of a former.
quotes.quote: The NBA Cup is moving out of Las Vegas after two glorious years and into the site of a former, and slightly less impressive, the movie Hoosiers, Hinkle Fieldhouse in Indianapolis.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Oscar Robertson won state championships at Hinkle Fieldhouse
quotes.excerpt: Oscar Robertson won a couple of state championships there.
quotes.quote: Oscar Robertson won a couple of state championships there. I honestly played like crap in pickup that night. I do think I abused Jackson though, but that's like a pretty low bar.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Bon Temps' podcast is mostly talking and little contribution
quotes.excerpt: Bon Temps' hoops like he podcasts, which means he talks a lot and contributes very little.
quotes.quote: Bon Temps' hoops like he podcasts, which means he talks a lot and contributes very little. But we seem to have found a mute button for him, which has been a pleasant development.
